==Problem==
Isabella had a week to read a book for a school assignment. She read an average of <math>36</math> pages per day for the first three days and an average of <math>44</math> pages per day for the next three days. She then finished the book by reading <math>10</math> pages on the last day. How many pages were in the book?


<math>\textbf{(A) }240\qquad\textbf{(B) }250\qquad\textbf{(C) }260\qquad\textbf{(D) }270\qquad \textbf{(E) }280</math>
==Solution==
Isabella read <math>3\cdot 36+3\cdot 44</math> pages in the first 6 days. Although this can be calculated directly, it is simpler to calculate it as <math>3\cdot (36+44)=3\cdot 80</math>, which gives that she read <math>240</math> pages. On her last day, she read <math>10</math> more pages for a total of <math>240+10=\boxed{\textbf{(B)}~250}</math> pages.
